title: Retail Assistant
content:
- Achieved a 97% mystery shopper score and employee of the month, highlighting exceptional customer service skills in a fast-paced retail environment.
- Excelled in managing multiple responsibilities, including taking drive-thru orders, preparing coffee, and handling customer inquiries simultaneously.
- Experienced in operating POS systems and managing cash transactions.

title: Sales Specialist
content:
- Specialised in bedroom furniture & PAX wardrobe design.
- Built rapport with business clients through phone calls, emails, and organisation of meetings. 
- Collaborated with the team to launch a virtual consultation service through Microsoft Teams, enabling higher client engagement and meeting FY2021 KPIs despite Melbourne lockdowns.
- Demonstrated a keen eye for detail in managing stock levels and creating visually appealing merchandise displays.

title: Service Desk Analyst
content:
- Managing IT incidents and service requests to provide technical support for end-users.
- Understanding of technical infrastructure projects and related technology dependencies.

title: Digital & Technology - Risk Advisory Intern
content:
- Achieved AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner through Deloitte Cloud Guild.
- Consolidated knowledge of AWS Cloud and its core services, security, architecture, pricing, and support.
- Familiarity with cloud computing security and data protection, including secure architecture design, network security, and incident response planning.
- Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) security best practices and the ability to integrate security into the SDLC.
- Assisted in the development, implementation and maintenance of SOX controls and processes in accordance with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act.
- Assisted in the successful implementation of a comprehensive business continuity plan that included disaster recovery strategies for various scenarios such as natural disasters, data breaches, and power outages.

title: Software Engineering Intern
content:
- Awarded the SummerTech LIVE studentship supported by the Victorian State Government.
- Built and deployed the MVP full-stack application for a financial planning startup, connecting consumers to financial planners, using Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS.

title: Machine Learning Intern
content:
- Contributed to current research project a part of Digital Innovation Lab.
- Implemented machine learning models to forecast smart city network performance using a 4G/5G dataset at Swinburne’s Digital Innovation Lab.
- Utilised SQL and Python libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow) to optimise application performance, incorporating hyper-parameter tuning to refine model accuracy.

title: Software Engineering Intern
content:
- As part of the selective IN2106 JavaScript Technology Praktikum (6–8% acceptance rate), collaborated with Maltego Technologies to enhance and deploy a big data analytics tool.
- Developed the frontend with Vite.js and TypeScript, integrated REST APIs, and participated in weekly stand-ups and agile sprints using Slack, Notion, and Linear.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
content:
- Member of the Technology Graduate 2025 Committee representing 230+ technology graduates across Australia, leading events and presenting at conferences to drive engagement and showcase leadership.

Rotation 1: Retail Technology (Full-Stack)
- Developed observability dashboards for fraud detection by implementing structured logging and aggregating non-production and production logs. The enhancement improved risk management, reduced scam and fraud incidents, strengthened customer safeguards, and was recognised with the FY25 Quarterly Excellence Award for digital onboarding improvements.
- Built and enhanced UI components using Next.js and TypeScript, including login flows and message alert banners, with robust error handling for a platform serving ~9 million active customers.
- Presented proof-of-concept solutions to Staff Engineer and UI/UX teams, rapidly iterating on designs based on stakeholder feedback.

Rotation 2: Business Banking (Backend/API)
- Developed and tested C#/.NET APIs using Bruno across multiple microservices, enhancing unit and integration test coverage, resolving SonarQube issues, and improving CI/CD pipelines.
- Authored technical documentation and implemented microservice database and schema updates to support new features and enhancements.
- Implemented GitHub Actions pipelines to deploy and decommission AWS ECS services, validating changes via AWS Console.
